population: All 105 pre-existing runs, 35 beta/wd cells x 3 seeds; 78 observed through 300k, 27 stop at 100k. Fixed p=59,L=2,r3,T4,M4. No new training or GPU. Frozen strict labels; reduced tests do not relabel.

observables.primary: C_sd, population standard deviation of the 60 signed direction-bin mean cosines of the joint total actual write. Use the archived continuous-correlation definition (original group-centering, per-example normalization, floor) at L2 query before residual and LayerNorm. Primary does not use task answers. C_add selects the known constant-sum direction to interpret it.
observables.strength: For each mode, mean over full 59x59 inputs of Euclidean length of its raw pre-residual, pre-LN, no-output-bias write u_m. A = sum of four means. Relative contributions q_m = A_m/A. Compare A multiplicatively using log(end/start); composition displacement = half sum of abs(q_m(end)-q_m(start)). No labels in A or q.
observables.secondary: Reuse parameter-only four-mode resultant P, saved post-LN rule energy D; keep D distinct from raw strength. For functional relevance consult separately verified inference interventions. No criterion tuned to amplitudes.

windows: All 58 strict cases; primary fixed numeric label window from end of uninterrupted low plateau to first observed test>=90. Sensitivity: last saved <=10% before first >=90 (recent visualization). Controls use the identical absolute window, beta and wd, other seeds; main controls never hit 90 over the entire observed 300k. Additionally report controls whose maximum stays <=10%, including separate train99 status. Otherwise unpaired. Count cases and pairs separately.
persistence: For a signed increase, count whether all observed postwindow values stay above the midpoint of the two endpoint readings and >=10k further measurement available. This measures retention of the net increase; report right-censored runs separately. For A use midpoint of log A. Do not interpret a seed count as a criticality test.
control_scan: For every same-cell control, compare net event changes against all of its equal-duration windows over its 300k history; report fraction exceeding or equal and highest. Repeated/matched windows are not independent replicates. For composition TV use actual four-share vectors at window endpoints; nonnegativity is guaranteed and not evidence.
control_axis: At fixed observation time, fixed wd and each of 3 seeds, find adjacent beta doubling with largest abs change in C_sd using all five beta values. Call a common sampled bracket only if same bin and same sign, and count only cells with all 15 actual observations at that horizon. No extrapolation at 200k/300k. No model size variation in this grid.
sampling: Read saved 500-step histories. Reuse validated CPU code for actual model operations and prior continuous-correlation computation. Pilot before selecting dense or uniformly thinned CPU replay. Include exact designated event endpoints and controls in all cases. Curves are averages; no smoothing. Preserve source and checkpoint integrity.
actual_sampling: Pilot verified three original CPU forward passes and per-mode strengths. Replay ALL 52,305 saved regular 500-step points for every run and metric, not just event windows. No 100k-only extrapolation.
specificity_detail: Also compare first completed 10%-90% window for the 25 learners that do not satisfy strict Grokking. Share-change persistence means each subsequent saved share vector is at least as close (total variation) to the end vector as to the start; require 10k followup. The prior uses the explicit arithmetic label window, repeated results use the recent graphical window as sensitivity.
